treatment_predictability.model: 12-32-16-1 MLP; 12 epochs; feature-only treatment predictability diagnostic
treatment_predictability.interpretation: descriptive source-eligibility diagnostic only; chance-level performance does not prove randomization or identify a causal propensity

interpretation_limits: The source aggregates multiple randomized incrementality tests and is non-uniformly subsampled.
The released file has no trial identifier, event time, or label-release time.
The exposure field is post-assignment and must not enter a targeting policy's features.
A feature-only treatment classifier is a diagnostic, not proof of the randomization mechanism.
Any treatment cost is research-imposed unless independently grounded.
